# Cortico extension tags

Pick every tag below that fits and list it in `cortico.tags` in package.json. The WebUI market groups and filters extensions by these tags and shows the hover hint to users.

```jsonc
"cortico": { "kind": "world", "api": 5, "tags": ["im", "qq", "companion"] }
```

## Not accepted in the market

An extension whose features or bundled content fall into any category below is blocked as soon as it reaches the market, with no warning first. An author blocked twice for the same category has their npm and GitHub accounts blocked permanently, which removes every package they publish.

1. **Model jailbreaks**: prompts, personas or tooling meant to get a model past its provider's safety rules.
2. **NSFW**: sexual content, or features for generating it.
3. **Security attacks and reverse engineering**: letting the bot scan or attack systems, write or run exploits or malware, crack license checks or DRM, or unpack and decompile software.
4. **Tracking third parties**: collecting, linking or keeping personal information about specific people other than the user, to profile, locate or monitor them, such as doxxing, matching someone's accounts across platforms, or covertly logging their chats. The chat context and memories a bot keeps for its own conversations do not count.
5. **Malicious code and impersonation**: stealing credentials, mining, backdoors, sending data out without telling the user, or posing as Pal AI Lab, Cortico or Coopanion.
6. **Cheats for online multiplayer games**: reading or writing game memory, injecting code or tampering with traffic to gain an unfair edge over other players.
7. **Spam and bulk automation**: mass messaging, fake likes, views or follows, or running batches of accounts.
8. **Content illegal in China**: political content, gambling, fraud.

## How to choose

- Choose by **what the extension connects to and what it lets the bot do**, not by how it is built. Calling an HTTP API is not `browser`; connecting to QQ is `qq`.
- An add-on pack for another extension carries its host's platform tag (QQ add-ons carry `qq`).
- Tag only what truly fits, not to appear in more filters. Use `apps` only when no other tag fits. If nothing fits, leave it empty and maintainers will correct it.
- Platform limits go in the standard npm `"os"` field (`["win32"]`, or `["!darwin"]` to exclude), not in tags.
- Notice and warning tags count only when listed in `cortico.tags`; `keywords` map to plain tags only.
- Run `pnpm check:extension <dir>` afterwards; tags outside this list are reported.

## Who adds and removes

| Level | Author | Maintainers |
|---|---|---|
| Official mark (blue) | cannot declare; ignored if listed | add and remove |
| Plain | add and remove | add and remove |
| Notice (yellow) | add; remove only what the author added | add and remove |
| Warning (red) | add; once any version declares it, it stays | add and remove |

Declare notice and warning tags yourself where they apply. Their absence means "not declared and not reviewed yet", not "safe".
To remove a tag added by maintainers, or withdraw a declared warning tag, open an issue in this repository titled `[tags] package-name`. The [README](README.md) gives the request format.

| id | Label | When to use | Hover hint shown to users | Existing examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `experimental` | Experimental | The author marks it as still in testing: features not settled, verified only in a few setups, or compatibility unconfirmed. | Marked as still in testing; features and compatibility may change. | `@wocwang/cortico-world-gpt-sovits-for-coopanion` `better-cortico-world-netease-companion` `cortico-bot-weighted-memory` `cortico-bot-weighted-memory-kpect` and 40 more |
| `internal-state` | Internal state | The World keeps and injects the bot's own internal state: mood, affinity, memories, experiences. We recommend building this into a bot extension's Persona instead. | This World manages the bot's internal state (mood, affinity, memories) outside the bot's Memory, so the bot's sense of itself may differ before and after it is installed or removed. | `cortico-world-affinity-alont1` `cortico-world-aigc` `cortico-world-alive-alont1` `cortico-world-dream` and 13 more |
| `requires-extension` | Requires other extensions | This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README. Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream. Bot extensions do not get this tag. | This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README.<br>Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream. | `cortico-provider-gemini-web` `cortico-world-affinity-alont1` `cortico-world-civ6-assistant-plus` `cortico-world-feeding` and 5 more |

| `unofficial-api` | Unofficial API | Calls a service with the user's own account in a way the service does not offer to third parties, so the account may be restricted or banned: unofficial IM clients such as NapCat, the internal endpoints and quotas of coding-agent apps, driving a web app as a model or service API, or automated writes (posting, liking, messaging) through a web login. Only reusing a login session to read what the user could see in a browser does not count; neither do undocumented endpoints that need no user account. | Uses your account through an unofficial client or an app's internal endpoint, or automates posting, messaging or a web app through your login; may break the service's terms and get the account restricted or banned. | `better-cortico-world-netease-companion` `coopani-world-music` `cortico-provider-deepseek-web` `cortico-provider-gemini-web` and 24 more |

## Warning tags

| id | Label | When to use | Hover hint shown to users | Existing examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unsafe` | Unsafe | The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write arbitrary files, or freely control the mouse and keyboard. | The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write any file, or control the mouse and keyboard. | `cortico-world-aigc` `cortico-world-browser` `cortico-world-cua-alont1` `cortico-world-feiyu-little-days` and 10 more |
| `sensitive-data` | Reads private data | Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone, foreground window or spending records, and sends it to the model endpoint with model calls. | Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone or windows, and sends it to your configured model endpoint. | `better-cortico-world-netease-companion` `coopani-world-music` `cortico-bot-weighted-memory` `cortico-bot-weighted-memory-kpect` and 30 more |
| `injection-risk` | Injection risk | Any text written by a third party (chat messages, nicknames or group names, comments, join-request messages, web pages, search results, scraped articles) goes into an event with origin 'internal', or otherwise reaches the conversation without the external-event framing. Fixed templates, the extension's own numbers and states, and notes the bot wrote with its own tools do not count. | Puts content written by others, such as group chat, comments or web pages, into the conversation as an internal notice without the external-message framing, so the model may follow instructions hidden in it. | `coopani-world-music` `cortico-world-alive-alont1` `cortico-world-feiyu-little-days` `cortico-world-gaming-alont1` and 5 more |

## Proposing a tag

Once at least 3 published extensions would use the tag, open an issue titled `[new-tag] id` or a PR against `index.json`. Give the label and hover hint in Chinese and English, and `when` in English.
